reason: The SOFC section of the report runs p.84-86: Tab. 55 gives the specifications of the 125-kWel SOFC system (efficiency, lifetime, stack composition) and Figures 31/32 give the mass and energy balance for heat and electricity supplied by hydrogen conversion in that SOFC, which is exactly this dataset (heat, residential, by conversion of hydrogen in an SOFC, allocated by exergy). The caption extraction found no 'Life-cycle inventories for the heat supply ... SOFC' table by name — the analogous PEM tables are Tab. 52/53 on p.80-81 — so this range is chosen because it is where the SOFC heat supply is quantified; the hydrogen production route (PEM electrolysis with Moroccan solar/wind electricity) is a separate upstream dataset documented elsewhere in the report.
